IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
 CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
 ANTICIPATORY BAIL APPLICATION NO. 2680 OF 2025
Rajesh Khemchand Chauhan & Anr. …Applicants
V/s.
The State of Maharashtra ...Respondent
Mr.  Viral  Rathod,  a/w  Mr.  Vishwatej  Jadhav,  Advocate  fo r  the
Applicants. 
Mr. P . H. Gaikwad, APP for the Respondent/State.
  
CORAM : N.R. BORKAR, J.
DATE      : 29.09.2025. 
 
P .C. :
1. This is an application for Anticipatory Bail.
2. The applicants are apprehending their arrest in Crime
No. 665 of 2025 registered at Nirmal Nagar Police Stati on, for the
offences  punishable  under  Sections  118(2),  118(1),  115(2) ,
189(2), 191(2), 190 & 352 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023. 
3. On  the  date  of  incident,  which  took  place  on
09.09.2025, a dispute arose between the first informant on  one
side and the applicants and the other co-accused on the oth er
side on account of previous enmity between them. It is allege d
that during the said dispute, the present applicants and o ther co-
Pramod S.Lakare
1/3

37-aba-2680-2025doc
accused assaulted to the first informant and others includ ing his
father  with  wooden  sticks  etc.  due  to  which  they  sustained
grievous injuries.
4. I have heard the learned counsel for the applicants and
the learned APP for the respondent-State. 
5. The  learned  counsel  for  the  applicants  submits  that
there is a cross FIR in relation to the incident in question . It is
submitted that there are no other criminal antecedents against
the applicant No.1.
6. On the other hand, the learned APP for the respondent-
State submits that the applicants assaulted the first informant and
others with wooden stick. It is submitted that the applicant  No.2 is
involved in one more crime. 
7. Admittedly,  there  is  a  cross  FIR  in  relation  to  the
alleged incident. The motive for the alleged incident is a ttributed
to the co-accused. In that view of the matter, I am inclined  to
release  the  applicants  on  anticipatory  bail.  In  the  result,  the
following order is passed :
Pramod S.Lakare
2/3

37-aba-2680-2025doc
O R D E R 
a) The Application is allowed. 
b) In  the  event  of  arrest  of  the  applicants  in
connection with  Crime No. 665 of 2025 registered
at  Nirmal  Nagar  Police  Station,  for  the  offences
punishable under Sections 118(2), 118(1), 115(2),
189(2), 191(2), 190 & 352 of the Bharatiya Nyaya
Sanhita, 2023, the applicants be released on bail on
furnishing P .R. Bond in the sum of Rs. 25,000/- each
with one or two sureties in the like amount.
c) The  applicants  shall  attend  the  concerned
police  station  as  and  when  called  by  the
investigating  officer  and  shall  co-operate  in  the
investigation.
d) Considering the fact that the applicant No.2
is involved in one more crime, he shall not enter
into the jurisdiction of the concerned police station
for a period one year.
[N.R.BORKAR, J.]
Pramod S.Lakare
3/3
